notes: Unsloth bf16 LoRA for Qwen3.5-9B is about 22GB, which does not fit on one 16GB card. device_map=balanced shards the model across both GPUs in a single process.
Do not launch this profile with torchrun or accelerate DDP. DDP keeps a full copy on every GPU, and Unsloth rejects device_map=balanced inside distributed mode.
The cards are not NVLink-connected. Sharding still works over PCIe and is slower. If either GPU runs out of memory, lower max_seq_length. Do not move layers to CPU.
